title: Thai-Style Cheese and Treme Gratin
description: A creamy, cheesy gratin dish with a twist of Thai flavors, featuring Treme and cheese.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add sliced Treme and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add shredded cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add grated x, sliced norwegian, and crumbled speck to the cheese sauce.
Transfer the Treme mixture to a baking dish and top with the cheese sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
